title: Predictive Modeling Project Context
summary: This project will develop a generic binary classification model for the following business objective: Develop a binary classification model that estimates the likelihood of bad credit performance within the governed HELOC population. The model output is intended to support this use: The model will support, but not replace, approved credit policies and qualified human judgment. The model will predict bad_flag = 1 represents Bad credit performance and bad_flag = 0 represents Good credit performance for The governed modeling population consists of the 6,275 records contained in the registered HELOC_TRAIN dataset version. The current deployment mode is Development. Dataset binding, target-column selection, validation design, and model selection will be established in later workflow stages.

payload.businessObjective: Develop a binary classification model that estimates the likelihood of bad credit performance within the governed HELOC population. The model will support credit-risk assessment, portfolio analysis, risk segmentation, and approved underwriting decision support.
payload.intendedModelUse: The model will support, but not replace, approved credit policies and qualified human judgment. Model scores may be used for credit-risk assessment, underwriting support, account review, portfolio segmentation, and prioritization subject to fair-lending, explainability, adverse-action, and model-governance requirements.
payload.targetDefinition: bad_flag = 1 represents Bad credit performance and bad_flag = 0 represents Good credit performance. RiskPerformance is the deterministic source used to derive the target and must be excluded from the predictor set.
payload.populationDefinition: The governed modeling population consists of the 6,275 records contained in the registered HELOC_TRAIN dataset version. Final eligibility criteria and exclusions must be confirmed against the source-data documentation and approved credit policy.
payload.observationWindow: The current Dataset Library metadata does not define the precise observation window. The data owner must document when predictor information was measured relative to the credit decision or account-performance assessment.
payload.performanceWindow: The current Dataset Library metadata does not define the period over which Good or Bad credit performance was observed. The approved performance window must be documented by the data owner before production use.
